title: 004 — Graded nearness: q-adic agreement depth, exact and holistic

sections.title: P1–P4 — role-wise graded nearness against MAP-I

legend.ex_q1: roles whose depth to the probe is right
legend.ex_us: one agreement_with call for all roles
legend.map_q2: clean-up to the nearest of 256 leaves; 10 records per m
legend.same_q1: MAP-I with n chosen so its counters use the exact record's bits

findings.label: P1–P4
findings.value: every role's depth is exact from one subtraction, at under a tenth of MAP-I's bits; MAP-I needs n = 10,000 and, to compare records role-wise, a clean-up, because without one the role cancels and only the whole-record similarity R_A · R_B remains

sections.title: P5 — the boundary: similarity that is not a shared prefix

legend.bag_ok: Σ of attribute vectors; 5,000 random pairs

findings.label: P5
findings.value: q-adic depth sees only the shared prefix: it equals the shared-attribute count for exactly 121/256 of pairs, where a VSA bag gets them all; the order of the levels is the model
